scope: Sequential local Debug filesystem observations; three samples per case/cache mode on frozen 16384-row eight-file Parquet source. Baseline overlaps compilation. Timings are observational and are not randomized paired trials.
report_excerpt_scope: All 48 timing/memory/sort profiles and complete input/configuration/executable/environment provenance; verbose Prometheus and shard snapshots omitted. Full report digests retained.
conclusion: Exact answers agree. Independent public-ID ordering uses bounded publication navigation instead of decorating all matches. Complete winning-ID endpoints prune equal primary groups. Batched authenticated lookup shares routing/leaf reads while retaining optional read quota and required reserve.

oracle_derivation.wide_tie_scope: All rows have revision=0; final public _id stays ASC in both revision directions. Common lake3 snapshot prefix cancels within the query.
oracle_derivation.public_file_digest_recipe: SHA256 of concatenated little-endian uint64 length-prefixed UTF-8 source_id, empty partition, file_id.
oracle_derivation.independence: Expected application IDs derive from declared input row ranges and public-ID encoding, independently of either query executor. The benchmark checks the same expected lists.

baseline.input_identity_contract: identity checked around launches/measurements and content verified before completion
